svg.text: D6 The Forbidden Zone (under the ruin of Castle Alamar on its mesa; the stair in the broken gatehouse's floor, D-49 Q5) · class M · party 58 → 61 · monsters 62–75, 34 · treasure 6 · M39 (Roland); Q-F1's key; Q-D26's hatch
